Strict Waveform layout for Journey Audio engine

<riff-ck><fmt-ck><data-ck> <ignored-ck>

------------------------------------------------------

<riff-ck> -> RIFF(<ck-size:DWORD> <form-type:DWORD>)

RIFFChunk :: struct{
 ck_id : DWORD,
 ck_size : DWORD,
 form_type : DWORD,
}

------------------------------------------------------

<fmt-ck> -> fmt(<common-fmt> <specific-fmt>)

FMTChunk :: struct{
 ck_id : DWORD,
 ck_size : DWORD,
 common : CommonFmt,
 specific : SpecificFmt,
}

<common-fmt> -> CommonFmt :: struct{
 format_tag : WORD,
 channels : WORD,
 sample_per_sec : DWORD,
 avg_byte_per_sec : DWORD,
 block_align : WORD,
}

<specific-fmt> -> SpecificFmt :: struct{
 bits_per_sample : WORD,
}


------------------------------------------------------

<data-ck> -> data(<wave-data>)

<wave-data> -> Data :: struct{
 ck_id : DWORD,
 ck_size : DWORD,
 samples : [u8*, u16*, s24*, f32*]
}
